messages:
Maria Chen: Draft for the launch blog is uploaded here: https://drive.redwood.example/launch-draft. Need quick signoffs on CTAs, webinar routing, and the benchmark blurb. Target publish window: tomorrow 11am PT.
AJ Patel: Skimmed — love the storytelling arc. Two asks: 1) tighten the benchmark paragraph (move it after the hero) and 2) map CTAs to HubSpot lists.
Devon Brooks: Can we A/B the hero CTA? Suggest CTA-A = 'See cost breakdown' and CTA-B = 'Book a demo'. Add UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_source=blog.
Kevin Ortiz: Hero image updated in the doc (mobile safe). Note: headline wraps on iPhone 12 — I trimmed 6 chars.
Sophia Li: Legal quick pass: ok overall. Flag on the line that says "lowest inference cost" — swap to "more cost-effective" or provide benchmark percent to substantiate.
Frank Gomez: Suggest adding a short customer quote under the benchmark section (anonymized). I'll draft one from the intake form.
AJ Patel: For webinar routing: we'll send registrants to HubSpot form id=12345. Need a webhook endpoint for registrant events (/webhooks/marketing/registrations). Also set email nurture: immediate confirm + 2 reminders.
Maria Chen: @Lina Morales can you confirm webinar capacity, calendar invite, and tracking? Also can Operations set the HubSpot form and webhook?
Lina Morales: Capacity confirmed for 500 registrants. I'll provision the Zoom webinar, configure HubSpot form id=12345, and set up the webhook to /webhooks/marketing/registrations (devops will need the secret). I can also schedule 2 reminder emails — send me copy.
Devon Brooks: For analytics, add a hidden field: variant=A/B so we can measure conversion per CTA. Also capture 'model_choice' param for downstream metrics.
Maria Chen: Noted. I'll update the draft with CTA variants, UTMs, and the legal wording change. Frank — please drop the customer quote by 2pm. Kevin — final hero image by 3pm.
Sophia Li: All set from legal after the wording tweak.
Maria Chen: Plan: finalize by EOD, hand to ops for form/webhook, then publish tomorrow 11am PT. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
